raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Customers migrated from the new CRM on 2026-01-15 carry numeric region codes ('01'-'04') in raw_customers, and silver_customers passes them through unmapped. raw_region_map supplies a unique, complete code-to-name mapping for exactly those four codes, so silver_customers should join it and fall back to the existing value for non-code rows.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.85, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_customers": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_customers AS SELECT c.customer_id, COALESCE(m.region_name, upper(c.region)) AS region FROM raw_customers c LEFT JOIN raw_region_map m ON c.region = m.region_code;"}}
